conditions.deliberative: Reason internally, then return the next legal action in the registered JSON format.
conditions.direct: Answer with the next legal action.

configuration_difference: Explicit auto provider-summary request; original observation boundary, parser, transition, grade, prompts, effort and action budget unchanged. Summary settings may influence generation, so comparisons remain separate.
provenance: Provider-returned reasoning items only, including brief headings. No private chain-of-thought reconstruction.
scope: Post-pilot public configuration-observability repeat: 8 episodes, one previously observed root, both hidden modes, all four arms. Not pooled with primary model scores, not a new independent cohort, not confirmatory, and not a model-level sham.
stopping_rule: Sequential fixed order. Preserve every request and response. Stop on a transport failure or the shared coordinator ordinary-allowance guard. No replacement scores or silent retries.
